description: Point Mapled's publish webhook at the site so published changes appear instantly. Optional: a site is connected once it reads content, so offer this after — it needs the person to place one secret on the host. Only for a site with a server that caches what it reads (Next.js and the like); a site rendered in the browser (react-spa, plain-html) shows a publish on the next load and needs none — call set_site_url for it instead. Pass the site's public revalidate URL (with @mapled/next: mount createRevalidateHandler from "@mapled/next/server" at /api/mapled/revalidate and pass that URL here). The webhook's signing secret never passes through you: the answer says how the person sets MAPLED_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the site's env — a secret shows once, so they get it with Rotate secret in Mapled → Integrations → Your site. Give them the whole way: in the project, the "Project settings" gear, the "Integrations" tab, the "Your site" card, the "Signing secret" row → "Rotate secret" → "Rotate" in the dialog → "Copy" next to the new secret; the bare value goes into MAPLED_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the host and in .env.local, then a redeploy; check: "Send test ping" shows "Delivered". The secret starts with whsec_ — the delivery key (mk_live_) and a server key (msk_live_) are the wrong ones. Don't ask them to paste it into the conversation. Local and private URLs are rejected; use the deployed site's URL. When the project already lives on another site (a webhook or a production domain on another origin), nothing changes yet: the answer is a confirmation with a reviewUrl — send it to the user, an owner confirms the move in Mapled, then poll get_confirmation. A new path on the same site is saved at once. Optional, when the owner wants pages that are already open to follow a publish without a reload (@mapled/next 0.8.0+): also mount createReleaseHandler({ key: process.env.MAPLED_KEY! }) from "@mapled/next/server" as GET at /api/mapled/release and render <MapledLive /> from "@mapled/next/live" once in the root layout. On the Pages Router (@mapled/next 0.9.0+) export createPagesReleaseHandler({ key: process.env.MAPLED_KEY! }) from "@mapled/next/server" as the default of pages/api/mapled/release.ts and render <MapledLive /> from "@mapled/next/live/pages" in pages/_app; there only pages that read in getServerSideProps follow a publish (the @mapled/next README, Live updates → Pages Router). Tabs poll the site's own route, never Mapled; then declare it in push_site_manifest's capabilities.
name: configure_revalidation
